headline: Forest leave Ipswich with a point after dominant chance creation

sentences.text: Nott'm Forest left Portman Road with a point after a 1–1 draw, but their attacking numbers suggest there was an opportunity for more.
Neco Williams put Forest ahead in the 13th minute, assisted by Daniel Muñoz, before Julio Enciso equalised for Ipswich in the 41st.
The sides went in level and neither found a second-half goal, so Forest had to settle for a share of the points.
Forest had 17 shots to Ipswich's 7 and registered 2.29 expected goals against 0.46, while possession was almost even at 50.6% to 49.4%.
That attacking edge makes the draw a frustrating result for Forest, especially with 5 corners to Ipswich's 0, though the scoreline stayed level after the break.
The point lifts Nott'm Forest from 19th before kick-off to 16th, with 6 points from 8 matches.
